scope: fixed-shape exact-oracle gfx950 attention tutorial variants

admitted.isolated_change: retain the original duplicate key read before explicit per-lane key reuse
admitted.shape: one FP32 head; K=V=16; T=1; initial and final matrix state
admitted.pipeline_assessment: the full state and output are resident in one workgroup; there is no streamed tile sequence for LDS multibuffering

admitted.isolated_change: unroll all eight recurrence steps directly instead of applying the production kernel's two exact C=4 WY/UT chunk transforms
admitted.shape: one FP32 head; K=V=16; T=8 as two C=4 chunks; initial and final matrix state
admitted.pipeline_assessment: the state stays in registers, but every token depends on the preceding updated state; the production WY/UT transform exposes independent within-chunk reductions

admitted.isolated_change: replace three normalized value divisions with one reciprocal after accumulating the weighted numerator
admitted.shape: one 16x16x128 E4M3 score tile; top two of four blocks; top three of 16 tokens; 16 output channels
admitted.pipeline_assessment: K=128 is exactly one native MFMA tile, leaving no next K tile for a useful ping-pong stage

admitted.isolated_change: restore four local and three global normalized divisions instead of the production kernel's two reciprocal reuses

admitted.pipeline_assessment: K=128 is exactly one native MFMA tile, leaving no next K tile for a useful ping-pong stage; final GPU6 evidence promoted reciprocal reuse into production

admitted.isolated_change: make the four fixed logits and weights explicit so each is loaded and evaluated once
admitted.pipeline_assessment: each channel is independent and the four-element softmax fits in registers

admitted.isolated_change: make all four fixed sigmoid-gated branches explicit

admitted.pipeline_assessment: each channel is independent and all branch values are register-local

admitted.isolated_change: retain the pre-wave16 scalar Sinkhorn mapping as the exact baseline for the distributed production kernel

admitted.pipeline_assessment: row normalization feeds column normalization in every iteration; the fixed matrix is register-local
